_about: Round 2 of the glutathione claims pass, 2026-09-23: what a store-wide survey found after configs/claim-fixes/glutathione-2026-09-23.json — the brightening-glow collection description ('reducing hyperpigmentation', a condition), two Brightening & Glow Duo FAQ answers ('more even tone', 'radiance'), the science page FAQ and its FAQ JSON-LD, the skin-concerns tile ('dark spots', 'post-inflammatory marks' next to the glutathione serum), the ingredients page glutathione block and the concern page's approach paragraph. Same rule as round 1: brightening is cosmetic (how skin looks), evenness and dark spots were never measured for GSSG, radiance was not measured. Left alone on purpose: the niacinamide, vitamin C and peptide lines on the ingredients page and the 'Boosted with Vitamin C & Niacinamide' benefit (formula-level claims, not assessed in the glutathione register), 'Many traditional brightening approaches are harsh' (acceptable while no product is named) and the skin-concerns FAQ mapping 'Brightening: uneven tone and dullness (Glutathione)' (logged as a follow-up).
